page_title: LAZ 1-1 TOR | Lazio v Torino 31/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
90+2' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Davide Massa didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+1' Lazio can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) replaces Gustav Isaksen.
86' Paolo Vanoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcus Pedersen (Torino) replacing Valentino Lazaro.
86' Che Adams goes off the pitch and Ivan Ilic (Torino) comes on.

84' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
82' 1 - 1 Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
78' Fine attempt! Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
76' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
76' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
75' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lazio have a free kick.
74' Adam Marusic (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Elseid Hysaj will be replaced by Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
73' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Pedro is replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
71' Substitution. Sebastian Walukiewicz did his best and is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
71' Substitution. Antonio Sanabria (Torino) on for Nikola Vlasic.
71' Substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cesare Casadei walks off.
70' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Lazio as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
69' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
68' There's a break in play and referee Davide Massa must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lazio using VAR. This could be interesting!

68' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
68' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

67' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes onto the pitch for Boulaye Dia.
65' The game is interrupted. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

62' Eljif Elmas (Torino) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Massa with no other option than to blow for a foul.
61' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
60' Eljif Elmas (Torino) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Ivan Provedel and he makes a comfortable save.

57' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Adam Marusic (Lazio) fires a brilliant volley inside the right post from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Pedro provided the assist. What a finish! 1:0.
57' Yellow card! It's like Samuele Ricci (Torino) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Davide Massa agrees and books him.
56' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Cesare Casadei (Torino) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
53' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) will take the corner.

52' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the top right corner, but Ivan Provedel pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
51' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
51' Pedro (Lazio) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
49' Samuele Ricci (Torino) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
47' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) is cleared away by the defence.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Davide Massa's book.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+3' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45+3' A cross from Adam Marusic (Lazio) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Lazio get a corner.
45+1' Davide Massa blows for a foul after Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Samuele Ricci (Torino) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
44' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
43' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
42' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
42' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
40' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) has received a yellow card for his foul.
38' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
37' The foul by Che Adams (Torino) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

36' Adam Marusic (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Torino) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
31' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tackles a bit over-zealously and Davide Massa blows for a foul.
28' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' This would have been a magnificent goal from Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
22' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Samuel Gigot (Lazio) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) is able to continue to play.
18' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
18' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
18' Pedro (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily deals with the threat.
16' Dangerous play by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
15' The game is interrupted. Cesare Casadei (Torino) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
14' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
13' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul. Lazio earn a free kick.

13' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot towards the roof of the net. His promising effort is kept out by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who pulls off a stunning save!
13' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Davide Massa pulls out a yellow card.
6' Saul Coco (Torino) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

5' Che Adams (Torino) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa will referee today's match.
